gold_policy: regenerated per arm with the arm instruction in the same position
instruction_position: prepended to user message; prefill unchanged (full prefix incl newline)
instruction_verbatim:
Before using any already-computed value in a later step, re-verify it by redoing its computation. If a value is wrong, correct it and continue from the corrected value.
Worked example (illustration only; not part of the task below and unrelated to it): an earlier step recorded total_apples = 6 + 5 = 12. Before reusing total_apples, re-add: 6 + 5 = 11, not 12, so the recorded value is wrong. Correct it to total_apples = 11, then continue every later step from 11 (e.g. if the next step is baskets = total_apples - 3, compute 11 - 3 = 8, not 9).
recompute_signature_def:
Mechanical, grep-able signature of explicit recomputation of the plant.

    Defined per non-blank continuation line:
      verb_lines        : lines that name the planted variable AND contain a
                          recompute/verify/correct verb (regex _RECOMP_VERB).
      true_rederive     : lines that name the planted variable AND contain the
                          TRUE value string (a re-derivation to the correct value).
      planted_flagged   : lines that name the planted variable AND contain the
                          PLANTED value string AND a recompute/correction verb
                          (an explicit call-out of the wrong value).
    All three are counts (>=0). A rollout "shows recomputation" iff
    (verb_lines + true_rederive) > 0. Var/value matching is substring on the
    rendered token; documented as coarse-but-conservative in the report.
